# Docmost files that the idq branch modifies, one per line, with the reason.
# These are the only places where merges from upstream can conflict, so keep
# the list short: see "Keeping upstream merges easy" in .github/README.md.
#
# The "upstream-files" CI check fails when a PR modifies a Docmost file that
# isn't listed here, and warns about listed files that are no longer modified.
#
# Format: <path>  # <reason>

apps/server/src/app.module.ts  # imports IdqModule, which registers every IDQ server feature
apps/client/src/App.tsx  # spreads idqLayoutRoutes and idqSettingsRoutes (apps/client/src/idq/routes.tsx)
apps/client/src/components/settings/settings-sidebar.tsx  # spreads idqAccountSettingsItems (apps/client/src/idq/settings-nav.ts)
apps/client/src/features/space/components/sidebar/space-sidebar.tsx  # renders IdqSpaceSidebarItems (apps/client/src/idq/space-sidebar-items.tsx)
apps/client/src/features/editor/full-editor.tsx  # renders IdqPageBlocks under the page title (apps/client/src/idq/page-blocks.tsx)
apps/client/src/components/layouts/global/global-sidebar.tsx  # spreads idqGlobalNavItems (apps/client/src/idq/global-nav.ts)
apps/client/src/pages/settings/account/account-settings.tsx  # renders IdqProfileSections (apps/client/src/idq/profile-sections.tsx)
